question: Which certifications do entry-level IT support jobs mention?
sources:
[1] IT Support Specialist at Creative Financial Staffing (CFS) (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-06)
Bonus Experience For The IT Support Specialist
Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certifications, Cisco Certifications, etc.

[2] Desktop Support Analyst at Social Capital Resources (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-11)
Education and Certifications
Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or similar certifications are a plus.

[3] Technical Support Representative at TEKsystems (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP) are desirable.

[4] IT Systems Administrator at Hendrickson (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Certifications: Current certifications in Cisco (such as CCNA) and Microsoft technologies (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals) are preferred but not mandatory.

[5] IT Service Desk Specialist at Bayforce (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Preferred certifications include CompTIA A+, Network+, MCSA
